cues.en: Let's talk about another developer fundamental and this one is commenting your code.
cues.zh: 來談另一個開發者基本功：替程式碼加註解。

cues.en: Up until now, you may have seen me comment, add comments to our scripts.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，可能看過我在腳本裡加入註解。

cues.en: For example, right here I added a comment of Booleans and this tells the Python interpreter, Hey, this is a comment, don't run this.
cues.zh: 例如這裡加了 Booleans 註解，告訴 Python 直譯器：「這是註解，不要執行。」

cues.en: It's just for me.
cues.zh: 「只是給我看的。」

cues.en: You can just ignore it and skip over to line two.
cues.zh: 「忽略它，直接到第二行。」

cues.en: And you saw that?
cues.zh: 看到了嗎？

cues.en: I simply did that in Python with the pound sign.
cues.zh: Python 裡，只要使用井字號 #。

cues.en: As soon as Python sees a pound sign, it adds a comment and you can do that after a line as well.
cues.zh: 看到 #，就表示後面是註解；也能加在某行程式後面。

cues.en: I can say this assigns to a variable.
cues.zh: 例如寫「這裡指定給變數」。

cues.en: And although this may look like two lines, it's actually just the ward rapping that's happening.
cues.zh: 雖然看起來像兩行，但其實只是畫面自動折行。

cues.en: And you can see that the interpreter just completely ignores these comments.
cues.zh: 可以看到，直譯器完全忽略這些註解。

cues.en: Now, commenting sounds very, very simple, but it's an important concept.
cues.zh: 註解聽起來簡單，卻是重要觀念。

cues.en: And if you want to be a good programmer in all languages, we have commenting.
cues.zh: 想成為好的程式設計師，各種語言都有註解可用。

cues.en: But there's good ways and bad ways of commenting.
cues.zh: 但註解有好寫法，也有壞寫法。

cues.en: And this is something that comes with practice.
cues.zh: 需要練習才能掌握。

cues.en: But here are some key guidelines.
cues.zh: 以下是幾個重要原則。

cues.en: When you're commenting your code, the idea is that you're adding valuable comments.
cues.zh: 替程式加註解，目的是提供有價值的說明。

cues.en: That is, if I add a comment here that says, Hey, this is a sign name variable, a value of Andre
cues.zh: 如果這裡加上「把字串 Andrei 指定給 name

cues.en: string, a comment like this.
cues.zh: 變數」這種註解，

cues.en: Is not really good.
cues.zh: 並不太好。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Well, because your code should be self explanatory, right?
cues.zh: 因為程式碼本身就應該清楚，對吧？

cues.en: The idea is for us to write code that is easy to read, easy to understand.
cues.zh: 我們要寫出容易閱讀、容易理解的程式。

cues.en: It's not trying to be clever.
cues.zh: 不是耍聰明。

cues.en: Instead, it should read like English.
cues.zh: 而是讀起來像英文。

cues.en: And any python programmer would know that here we're just simply adding Andre as a value of name.
cues.zh: 任何 Python 程式設計師，都知道這裡只是把 Andrei 指定給 name。

cues.en: We're assigning a variable and adding a comment like this that's self explanatory.
cues.zh: 這就是變數指定，加入這種一看就懂的註解，

cues.en: Just adds clutter to your code.
cues.zh: 只是讓程式更雜亂。

cues.en: So there's a trade off here.
cues.zh: 所以要取捨。

cues.en: It's good to comment your code for let's say if you're working on teams and other developers come and they want to understand your code.
cues.zh: 加註解是好事，例如團隊合作，其他開發人員想理解你的程式時。

cues.en: But you have to remember this principle of code being easy to read.
cues.zh: 但要記得，程式本身要容易讀。

cues.en: The only time you want to add comments to your code is.
cues.zh: 只有在以下情況，才有必要加註解，

cues.en: Well, when something really, really important is happening, where it might be a little complex,
cues.zh: 例如正在處理很重要、可能比較複雜的事情，

cues.en: you first decide, Hey, is this code written in a way that makes sense?
cues.zh: 先問自己：這段程式寫得合理、清楚嗎？

cues.en: For example, if this was variable a.
cues.zh: 例如，如果這叫變數 a，

cues.en: And this was variable B.
cues.zh: 那個叫變數 b，

cues.en: Well, this might be really hard for somebody to understand.
cues.zh: 別人可能很難理解。

cues.en: So you might say that this is is flag.
cues.zh: 於是想寫註解，說明這是個旗標。

cues.en: But before you add that comment, you want to say to yourself, Hmm, maybe my code is hard to read.
cues.zh: 但寫之前，要先想：嗯，也許是我的程式不好讀。

cues.en: Maybe I should just change the variable to is cool to make it more understandable.
cues.zh: 或許只要把變數改叫 is_cool，就更容易理解。

cues.en: Now this is something that you improve upon more and more, and you do want to use comments as an extra tool to make your code understandable.
cues.zh: 這會越練越好。註解是讓程式容易理解的額外工具。

cues.en: Maybe you write code that six months from now you want to go back to understand what you did.
cues.zh: 也許六個月後，你想回頭看懂自己當初做了什麼。

cues.en: But remember, more comments doesn't necessarily mean better code.
cues.zh: 但記得，註解更多，不一定代表程式更好。

cues.en: You want to be concise and keeping things simple while adding comments only when necessary to help others
cues.zh: 應該簡潔、保持簡單，只在必要時加註解，幫助別人

cues.en: understand your code, not trying to make your unreadable code more readable.
cues.zh: 理解程式，而不是試圖用註解，補救原本難以閱讀的程式。

cues.en: We'll explore this topic and give you advice on it throughout the course.
cues.zh: 整門課會繼續探索這個主題，提供建議。

cues.en: But remember this key developer fundamental because you're going to need it throughout your career.
cues.zh: 但請記得這個基本功，整個職涯都會需要。

cues.en: By the way, this article over here has some really important points that I think you'll really benefit
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這篇文章有些很重要的觀念，我認為你會很受用，

cues.en: from, especially in the commenting best practices.
cues.zh: 尤其是註解的最佳實務。

cues.en: You can read some of the do's and don'ts and what some of the top programmers do when commenting.
cues.zh: 可以看看該做與不該做的事，以及頂尖程式設計師怎麼寫註解。

cues.en: I know it sounds silly, but it is an important concept that most courses overlook, so I highly recommend you read over this.
cues.zh: 聽起來或許小題大作，但這是多數課程忽略的重要觀念，我很推薦讀一下。

cues.en: I'll link to it in the resources and I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 我會把連結放在資源區，下支影片見。
